title: Local pollution, not Indon haze, forces 4 Cebu cities to suspend classes

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Worsening air pollution from local emissions, and not transboundary haze from Indonesia, has prompted four cities in Metro Cebu to suspend face-to-face classes on Monday, Oct. 12. The cities of Cebu, Mandaue, Lapu-Lapu and Talisay announced on Sunday, Oct. 11, class suspensions following reports of deteriorating air quality across Metro Cebu. As of 6:30 p.m. on Sunday, air quality index (AQI) here reached 180, which falls under the ‘very unhealthy category.’ In Cebu City, Mayor Nestor Archival ordered all public and private schools to suspend in-person classes and shift to asynchronous learning on Monday.
